'''Hadlress Defense Systems, Limited''' was a company that manufactured security systems<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|5|Hadlress Defense Systems, Limited}}</ref> on [[Hadlress]]. [[Jasis Temm]] once owned and operated the company, but it was sold for 4.6 billion [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="BM" />
